items.label: Morning executive review
stepTexts: User opens the platform and lands on Overview with All Clinics or their default clinic selected.
The KPI strip loads current red and amber indicators; the user selects a card such as “Doctor pay blocked”.
A filtered detail drawer opens showing affected clinic, pay period, blocker, owner and due date.
The user clicks Open Source Record and is taken to the relevant module and exact item.
After the item is resolved, the dashboard status updates and the activity remains in history.

items.label: Compare clinic performance
stepTexts: User opens Clinic Health and selects the comparison period.
The page displays clinic cards ordered by risk or score.
User selects two or more clinics and clicks Compare.
A comparison view shows KPI definitions, current value, trend, threshold and underlying exceptions.
User clicks Create Management Action on a weak area, assigns an owner and due date, and the action appears in Action Inb

items.label: Produce management pack
stepTexts: User opens Reports and chooses Monthly Operations Pack.
A preview shows included clinics, period, KPI sections, unresolved risks and commentary fields.
User adds management commentary and excludes any section they are not authorised to share.
User clicks Generate Report, reviews the final preview and exports the approved pack.
The generated report is stored in report history with creator, date and filters.

items.label: Role-Based My Day User Journey
stepTexts: User signs in and lands on My Day for the default clinic and current date.
The page displays today's shift, clocking status, opening/closing duty, checklists, tasks, training and alerts.
The user selects the next required action, such as Clock In, Start Opening Checklist or View Shift.
Completed items leave the urgent area and remain visible in the daily timeline.
Unfinished items are included in the next handover or manager exception queue.
The user may switch clinic or date only where access permits.

items.label: Review and approve an item
stepTexts: User opens Approvals and filters by clinic or module.
User selects an item; the right panel displays summary, evidence, prior comments and decision impact.
User clicks Approve or Request Changes.
A confirmation modal shows any downstream effect, such as publishing a roster or moving a pay run forward.
The decision is saved, the source record changes status and affected users receive notification.

items.label: Resolve an exception
stepTexts: User opens Exceptions and selects an attendance or checklist exception.
The panel shows the exception reason, affected workflow and blocking consequence.
User chooses Resolve, Reassign or Open Source depending on authority.
If an override is used, the user enters a mandatory reason and confirms the risk.
The item leaves the active queue only when the source record is no longer blocked.

items.label: Escalate overdue work
stepTexts: A manager opens Team Queue and sorts by days overdue.
The manager selects one or more items and clicks Escalate.
The escalation modal requires escalation owner, reason, new due date and notification recipients.
The items move to Escalations and display the escalation level.
When resolved, the history records original owner, escalation and final outcome.

items.label: Approval Delegation and Absence Cover
stepTexts: Approver opens Delegations and clicks Create Delegation.
The approver selects the delegate, relevant modules, clinics, authority level and start/end dates.
A preview lists approvals and queues that will redirect.
Higher-risk or broad delegations are submitted for owner approval.
During the active period, the delegate sees eligible actions labelled Acting on behalf of.
The delegation ends automatically or may be ended early with a reason.
A post-delegation report shows all decisions taken, unresolved items and any exceptions.

items.label: Add a clinic
stepTexts: Administrator opens Clinics and clicks Add Clinic.
A stepper opens for Identity, Contact, Hours, Rooms, Responsibilities and Alerts.
Administrator assigns responsible manager, nurse and escalation contacts.
A review screen highlights missing mandatory information.
Administrator clicks Activate Clinic; the clinic becomes selectable in approved modules.

items.label: Onboard a user
stepTexts: Administrator opens Users and clicks Invite User.
The form captures identity, contact, user type and employment relationship.
Administrator selects one or more clinics and assigns a role template.
A permission preview shows what the user can view and change.
Administrator confirms the invitation; the user remains Pending until activation requirements are met.

items.label: Suspend and offboard access
stepTexts: Manager opens a user profile and clicks Suspend or Start Offboarding.
A modal asks for effective date, reason and whether temporary or permanent.
The system displays impacted shifts, tasks, approvals, remote access and sensitive permissions.
Manager reassigns owned work and confirms access removal checklist.
The user is prevented from new activity while historical records remain visible.

items.label: Conduct access review
stepTexts: Authorised reviewer opens Access Reviews and selects clinic and review period.
The page lists active users, last activity, roles, sensitive permissions and exceptions.
Reviewer confirms, changes or removes each questionable permission.
Reviewer adds an overall sign-off comment and completes the review.
A review report is stored and unresolved changes enter Action Inbox.

items.label: First-Time Access, Sign-In Recovery and Account Lockout
stepTexts: Invited user opens the invitation and confirms identity.
User creates sign-in details and completes required security setup.
A preview shows assigned clinics, role and permitted modules.
User accepts required privacy, security and acceptable-use acknowledgements.
User completes any mandatory profile setup and enters a guided first-use tour.
If access fails later, the user selects Reset Password, Unlock Account or Contact Administrator.
Sensitive recovery requests enter the administrator queue and are closed only after identity and authority are confirmed

items.label: Approval Delegation and Absence Cover
stepTexts: Approver opens Delegations and clicks Create Delegation.
The approver selects the delegate, relevant modules, clinics, authority level and start/end dates.
A preview lists approvals and queues that will redirect.
Higher-risk or broad delegations are submitted for owner approval.
During the active period, the delegate sees eligible actions labelled Acting on behalf of.
The delegation ends automatically or may be ended early with a reason.
A post-delegation report shows all decisions taken, unresolved items and any exceptions.

items.label: Clinic Opening, Relocation, Temporary Closure and Permanent Closure
stepTexts: Authorised user selects Start Clinic Transition and chooses the transition type.
The guided impact assessment identifies affected staff, doctors, future rosters, assets, stock, suppliers, phone/website
Actions, owners and due dates are assigned for each affected area.
Communications are drafted, reviewed and approved for relevant audiences.
Staff, doctors, assets, stock, contracts and open responsibilities are transferred, suspended or closed.
The readiness dashboard is reviewed and unresolved blockers are escalated.
Final approver confirms the effective date and changes the clinic status.
Historical records remain available under the former location and the transition receives a post-change review.

items.label: Workforce Data Access and Correction Request
stepTexts: User opens self-service and submits an access or correction request.
The request identifies the record/category and explains the requested correction where applicable.
Authorised owner reviews identity, scope, sensitivity and any linked legal/retention restriction.
For access, permitted information is prepared and restricted third-party or sensitive information is excluded where appr
For correction, the source owner approves, rejects or requests evidence.
Approved correction updates the source record through normal version/history rules.
The user receives the outcome, reason and completion date.
The request closes with a retained response history.

items.label: Add a staff member
stepTexts: HR user opens Staff Directory and clicks Add Staff.
The wizard opens at Basic Details; the user enters name, contact, emergency contact and preferred communication.
Employment & Locations captures role, employment type, default clinic, additional clinics, start date and manager.
Award & Pay Profile captures approved classification mapping without duplicating payroll calculations.
Documents & Readiness shows required uploads and training; the profile can be saved as Draft.
Reviewer clicks Activate once mandatory items are complete; the person becomes selectable for permitted rosters and task

items.label: Add a doctor
stepTexts: Authorised user opens Doctor Directory and clicks Add Doctor.
The wizard captures business identity, ABN/GST status, contact, payment email and clinic assignments.
Contract & Payment captures percentage or agreed rule, effective date, payment cycle and bank details with restricted vi
Credentials captures required evidence and expiry dates.
A review screen shows Doctor Pay and BBPIP readiness.
Approver activates the profile; future transactions use the effective contract rule.

items.label: Request and approve leave
stepTexts: Staff member opens Leave / Away Days and clicks Request Leave.
The form captures dates, type, notes and attachment where required.
A coverage preview shows rostered shifts and potential gaps.
Manager receives an Action Inbox approval and approves, rejects or requests changes.
Approved leave updates the calendar and triggers roster warnings for affected planning periods.

items.label: Renew an expiring document
stepTexts: The expiry dashboard flags an approaching certificate or credential.
Owner clicks Send Reminder or opens the person’s document panel.
Staff/doctor uploads replacement evidence and submits it for review.
Reviewer verifies dates and status, then approves or rejects with reason.
The new version becomes Current; the prior version remains in history.

items.label: Offboard a worker
stepTexts: Manager clicks Start Offboarding from the profile.
The checklist identifies future shifts, open tasks, approvals, training, assets, remote access and sensitive permissions
Owners are assigned for reassignment, asset return and document completion.
Access is suspended on the effective date and open work is reassigned.
Reviewer signs off the checklist and the profile becomes Archived while history remains reportable.

items.label: Leave Amendment, Cancellation and Return to Work
stepTexts: Staff member opens approved leave and selects Amend or Cancel.
The page displays affected rosters, duties and pay periods.
The staff member enters the requested change and submits it.
Manager approves, rejects or requests changes after reviewing coverage and payroll impact.
Approved changes update the leave calendar and create roster/pay warnings where required.
On return, the staff member or manager completes Return to Work confirmation where applicable.
Any temporary restrictions or follow-up actions are recorded with controlled visibility and an end/review date.

items.label: Worker Transfer, Promotion and Employment Change
stepTexts: HR opens the worker profile and clicks Start Employment Change.
User selects transfer, promotion, role change, manager change, employment-type change or clinic reassignment.
The impact panel identifies permissions, roster, training, award/pay and work-ownership consequences.
Required new documents, training and approvals are assigned.
Approvers review the before-and-after summary and effective date.
On approval, the new arrangement becomes active on the effective date.
Previous arrangements remain visible in history and affected users receive notifications.

items.label: Credential Expiry, Suspension and Reactivation
stepTexts: Reminder actions are issued before expiry according to the credential rule.
If the credential expires, the profile changes to Not Ready or Restricted for affected duties.
The manager reviews future rosters, checklists and responsibilities impacted by the expiry.
Manager removes/reassigns affected work, suspends eligibility or records an authorised temporary exception.
The worker uploads updated evidence and submits it for verification.
Reviewer approves or rejects the renewal.
On approval, the credential becomes Current and eligible duties are reactivated from the approved date.

items.label: Doctor Bank Detail Change and Verification
stepTexts: Doctor or authorised finance user clicks Request Bank Detail Change.
New details are entered and remain Pending Verification; approved current details remain active.
The approved verification procedure is completed and evidence/reference is recorded.
Where required, a second authorised approver confirms or rejects the change.
The effective date is set and the doctor receives confirmation through the approved channel.
Doctor Pay displays a warning for pay runs affected by the change date.
Previous details remain restricted in effective-dated history.

items.label: Workforce Data Access and Correction Request
stepTexts: User opens self-service and submits an access or correction request.
The request identifies the record/category and explains the requested correction where applicable.
Authorised owner reviews identity, scope, sensitivity and any linked legal/retention restriction.
For access, permitted information is prepared and restricted third-party or sensitive information is excluded where appr
For correction, the source owner approves, rejects or requests evidence.
Approved correction updates the source record through normal version/history rules.
The user receives the outcome, reason and completion date.
The request closes with a retained response history.

items.label: Build and publish roster
stepTexts: Manager opens Week View and selects clinic, week and role view.
Manager copies a prior week or starts from a template.
Shifts are added or adjusted and staff are assigned from an eligibility list.
Manager clicks Validate Roster; blocking issues and warnings appear in a drawer.
Manager resolves gaps or records authorised overrides.
Manager clicks Publish, confirms notification recipients and the roster becomes visible to staff.

items.label: Staff shift-swap request
stepTexts: Staff member opens My Roster, selects a shift and clicks Request Swap / Release.
The request drawer shows eligible replacement staff and the duties that will transfer.
Staff member selects a proposed replacement, adds reason and submits.
Replacement acceptance is captured where required, then the manager reviews warnings and impact.
On approval, the published roster changes, duties transfer and affected users are notified.

items.label: Emergency roster change
stepTexts: Manager clicks Emergency Change on the affected shift.
The modal requires emergency reason, replacement, timing and approver.
The page shows conflicts, hours and duty impact but permits an authorised override.
Manager confirms; notifications are sent immediately.
The change is tagged Emergency and appears in the stability report and audit history.

items.label: Open Shift and Urgent Coverage Broadcast
stepTexts: Manager selects an uncovered shift and clicks Create Open Shift.
Eligible staff are filtered using role, clinic access, availability, leave, training status, current hours and conflicts
Manager selects the offer audience and response deadline.
Eligible staff receive the offer and choose Accept or Decline.
If multiple staff accept, the manager reviews suitability and selects the final assignment.
Roster validation checks conflicts, hours and transferred duties.
The manager confirms the assignment; the roster and opening/closing responsibilities update and all affected users are n

items.label: Normal clock-in/out
stepTexts: Staff member opens My Clock and sees the current rostered shift.
Staff clicks Clock In; the screen confirms clinic, shift and timestamp.
During the shift, Start Break and End Break update the live status.
At completion, staff clicks Clock Out and reviews the shift summary.
A clean shift moves automatically to the manager’s timesheet review without an exception.

items.label: Missed punch correction
stepTexts: Staff member clicks Report Missed Punch and selects the affected shift.
The form captures missing event, proposed time, reason and optional evidence.
Manager receives an exception item and compares roster, recorded events and note.
Manager approves, adjusts or rejects the proposed correction with reason.
The timesheet recalculates and the decision is retained in Approval History.

items.label: Pay-period attendance approval
stepTexts: Manager opens Timesheets for the pay period and filters to Unresolved.
The screen groups clean timesheets and exception-affected timesheets.
Manager bulk-approves clean records, then opens each exception for decision.
When all blockers are resolved, manager clicks Approve Period.
Payroll users see the location as Ready in Staff Pay.

items.label: Prepare a pay run
stepTexts: Payroll user selects the pay period and clicks Create Pay Run.
The module loads approved attendance, leave and current classification mappings.
The control tower identifies clinics and staff that are Ready or Blocked.
Payroll user resolves exceptions through the linked source records.
Once clear, payroll user clicks Recalculate and reviews totals and variances.
Each clinic is approved and the full run moves to Final Review.

items.label: Export and reconcile
stepTexts: Authorised user opens Export & Reconciliation and reviews the final checklist.
User clicks Export to Xero and confirms included employees and period.
The generated output is recorded with version and totals.
After payroll processing outside the platform, the user returns and records reconciliation result and notes.
The period is marked Reconciled and Locked.

items.label: Correct a prior period
stepTexts: Payroll user opens History and selects a locked period.
User clicks Reopen with Approval and enters reason and affected staff.
An elevated approver reviews the financial and reporting impact.
On approval, only authorised corrections can be made and a new version is created.
The corrected output is re-exported and both versions remain in history.

items.label: Payroll Export Rejection, Final Pay and Overpayment Correction
stepTexts: For export rejection, payroll opens the failed output, reviews employee-level errors, corrects the source records and ge
For final pay, offboarding creates a final-pay action covering approved hours, leave, allowances and outstanding correct
Payroll reviews and approves final-pay inputs, exports the result and records reconciliation.
For overpayment or underpayment, payroll records the variance, affected period, likely cause and communication requireme
The correction method and approval are recorded.
The adjustment is processed in the appropriate pay period or external process.
The original, replacement and correction records remain linked in history.

items.label: Full doctor pay run
stepTexts: Finance user opens Pay Run, selects the payment cycle and clicks Import / Refresh Transactions.
Transactions are matched to doctor and clinic; unmatched items appear in a blocking queue.
User resolves unmatched items and clicks Calculate Pay Run.
The platform applies the effective contract rule, GST treatment and approved adjustments.
User opens Reconciliation, compares source totals, exclusions and calculated payable amounts, and resolves variances.
User clicks Submit for Approval; the authorised approver reviews summary and doctor-level detail.
After approval, user clicks Generate Payslips, previews them and confirms Email Payslips and Publish to Portal.
An authorised user completes the bank transfer outside the platform.
The user returns to Manual Payments, records transfer details and clicks Mark Completed.
When every doctor is resolved, the pay run is Locked.

items.label: Add an adjustment
stepTexts: User opens a doctor in Adjustments and clicks Add Adjustment.
A modal captures category, amount, GST treatment if relevant, reason, evidence and effective pay run.
The adjustment enters Pending Approval and recalculates the provisional amount.
Approver reviews the adjustment in Action Inbox and approves or rejects it.
Approved adjustment appears on the reconciliation and payslip with a clear label.

items.label: Reissue a payslip
stepTexts: Finance user opens Payslips and selects the original document.
User clicks Reissue and chooses correction, recipient update or delivery retry.
For a financial correction, the pay run must be reopened through the authorised correction workflow.
A new version is generated with reissue reason and reference to the original.
The new payslip is emailed/published and the email log records the outcome.

items.label: Doctor self-service review
stepTexts: Doctor opens Doctor Portal and sees recent pay cycles and status.
Doctor selects a cycle to view payslip, transaction schedule and payment status.
Doctor clicks Raise Query if clarification is needed and enters a category and message.
The query creates a finance action linked to the exact pay run and doctor.
Finance responds and the query history remains visible to the doctor.

items.label: Doctor Bank Detail Change and Verification
stepTexts: Doctor or authorised finance user clicks Request Bank Detail Change.
New details are entered and remain Pending Verification; approved current details remain active.
The approved verification procedure is completed and evidence/reference is recorded.
Where required, a second authorised approver confirms or rejects the change.
The effective date is set and the doctor receives confirmation through the approved channel.
Doctor Pay displays a warning for pay runs affected by the change date.
Previous details remain restricted in effective-dated history.

items.label: Doctor Pay Dispute, Failed Transfer and Partial Payment
stepTexts: Doctor selects a payslip or transaction and clicks Raise Pay Query.
Doctor chooses a category such as missing activity, calculation issue, adjustment dispute, GST issue or payment not rece
Finance accepts the query, reviews linked source information and requests further information where needed.
If a financial correction is required, the authorised pay-run reopening and reissue process is followed.
If a transfer failed or was returned, finance records the payment exception and verifies approved bank details.
For partial payment, the paid amount is recorded and the remaining balance stays open.
Replacement payment details are recorded after the manual transfer is completed.
Finance sends the outcome to the doctor and closes the dispute only after resolution is confirmed.

items.label: Create a forecast
stepTexts: User opens Forecast, selects period and clicks Refresh Approved Data.
The module displays source completeness and any blocking gaps.
User resolves or assigns gaps, then clicks Run Forecast.
The estimate displays by clinic and doctor with assumptions and confidence level.
User submits the estimate for review and the approver confirms or requests changes.
Approved forecast becomes the current management baseline.

items.label: Resolve a compliance gap
stepTexts: User opens Compliance Gaps and selects an item.
The panel explains the missing evidence, affected period and estimated impact.
User assigns an owner and due date or links existing evidence.
Reviewer verifies the evidence and marks the gap Resolved or Not Applicable with reason.
Forecast confidence and affected totals update after the next refresh.

items.label: Reconcile actual outcome
stepTexts: Finance user opens Reconciliation and enters or imports the approved actual result.
The module compares actual result to the latest approved forecast.
User categorises each material variance and adds supporting notes/evidence.
Approver reviews the reconciliation and clicks Finalise Period.
The period is locked and appears in history with forecast accuracy metrics.

items.label: Build and publish a checklist
stepTexts: Manager opens Template Builder and clicks Create Checklist Template.
The stepper captures name, purpose, location, role, frequency and active period.
Manager adds sections and item types, marks mandatory items and defines evidence for failed/skipped responses.
Assignment step previews which staff or shifts will receive the checklist.
Reviewer checks the template and clicks Publish.
The template becomes active at the next scheduled occurrence and prior versions remain in history.

items.label: Complete opening checklist
stepTexts: Rostered opening staff opens Opening / Closing from the shift card.
The active checklist shows ordered items and required evidence.
Staff completes items; a failed item prompts reason and displays Raise Ticket or Raise Incident.
Staff signs off and submits the checklist.
Manager sees completion status and any exception action in the review queue.

items.label: Conduct a management meeting
stepTexts: Chair opens Meetings and clicks Create Meeting.
Chair selects a template, clinic/group scope, attendees, agenda and linked reports.
During the meeting, decisions and notes are recorded; clicking Add Action captures owner, due date and linked module.
Chair reviews minutes and clicks Publish Minutes.
Open actions move to Action Register and automatically carry into the next meeting until closed.

items.label: Close a task/action
stepTexts: Owner opens My Tasks or Action Register and selects the item.
Owner adds outcome, evidence and any follow-up.
If approval is required, the item moves to manager review.
Approver confirms completion or reopens with reason.
Closed item remains searchable and included in completion reporting.

items.label: Daily and Shift Handover
stepTexts: Outgoing user clicks Create Handover near the end of the shift or day.
The platform suggests unresolved operational items from linked modules.
User confirms relevant items and adds concise operational notes without unnecessary patient information.
Each item is assigned to the incoming person, role or manager.
Incoming user opens the handover and acknowledges receipt.
High-risk or unacknowledged items escalate according to due time and severity.
The handover closes when required items are acknowledged, while individual actions remain open until resolved.

items.label: Missed Checklist, Retrospective Completion and Waiver
stepTexts: A scheduled checklist remains unstarted or incomplete after the due threshold.
The assigned user and manager receive an alert.
Manager reviews the operational context and selects Complete Late, Reassign, Mark Not Required or Record Operational Fai
Late completion requires a reason and evidence where defined.
A waiver requires an authorised reason and does not appear as normal completion.
High-risk missed controls create an incident or management action.
The occurrence closes with its true outcome and appears correctly in compliance reporting.

items.label: Create and assign learning
stepTexts: Training admin opens Catalogue and clicks Create Course.
The builder captures title, purpose, content, assessment, pass mark, validity period and certificate requirement.
Admin selects assignment rules by role, clinic or individual.
A preview lists affected people and due dates.
Admin publishes the course; assignments appear in My Learning and notifications are sent.

items.label: Complete training
stepTexts: User opens My Learning and selects an assigned course.
The course screen shows sections, progress and required assessment or acknowledgement.
User completes content and submits the assessment.
On pass, completion is recorded and a certificate is generated or upload requested.
If failed, the user receives feedback and a reassessment action according to the course rule.

items.label: Record observed competency
stepTexts: Manager opens Competencies and selects a person and competency.
The form displays the observation checklist and required evidence.
Manager records outcome, date, notes and next review date.
If competent, readiness updates; if not yet competent, remedial training/action is assigned.
The competency remains available in the person’s training history.

items.label: Training Exemption, Prior Learning and Role-Change Reassignment
stepTexts: User or manager opens the training requirement and clicks Request Exemption / Prior Learning.
Evidence, issuing body, completion date and validity period are submitted.
Training administrator reviews the evidence and approves, rejects or requests more information.
Approved exemption satisfies the requirement until its expiry or review date.
When a person changes role or clinic, the module compares old and new learning rules.
Required new assignments are created with due dates.
No-longer-required assignments are closed with a clear reason rather than deleted.

items.label: Close an accreditation gap
stepTexts: Lead opens Gap Register and selects a requirement.
The panel shows current status, missing evidence, owner and due date.
Lead creates or assigns gap actions and links relevant policy, checklist, training or ticket records.
When actions are complete, lead uploads/links evidence and submits for review.
Reviewer confirms the evidence and changes the requirement to Met or returns it with comments.

items.label: Run a PDSA cycle
stepTexts: User opens QI / PDSA and clicks Start PDSA.
Plan captures problem, baseline, proposed change, measure, owner and timeframe.
During Do, actions and observations are recorded.
Study compares results to baseline and captures learning.
In Act, the owner adopts, adapts or abandons the change and creates follow-up policy/training/checklist actions.

items.label: Handle a cold-chain exception
stepTexts: Nurse records a temperature reading in Nursing & Cold Chain.
An out-of-range value opens an exception modal requiring time, device, stock impact and immediate action.
The module prompts escalation, evidence and whether an incident/ticket is required.
Manager reviews and records disposition and corrective action.
The exception is included in compliance evidence and trend reporting.

items.label: Process regulatory change
stepTexts: Compliance owner adds a regulatory change with effective date and source summary.
Impact assessment identifies affected clinics, policies, training, checklists, communications and records.
Actions are assigned and tracked through Action Inbox.
Owner reviews evidence of implementation before the effective date.
The change is marked Implemented and scheduled for post-implementation review.

items.label: Process document intake
stepTexts: Admin opens Intake Queue and selects an incoming item.
A classification drawer shows preview, suggested category, sensitivity and possible linked module.
Admin confirms category, clinic and owner, then chooses File, Create Action or Reject as Duplicate/Irrelevant.
If review is required, the item enters the owner’s Action Inbox.
After filing, the intake record shows destination and processing outcome.

items.label: Publish a controlled policy
stepTexts: Document owner opens Policies & SOPs and clicks Create New.
Owner starts from a template or uploads a draft, completes metadata and sets affected roles/clinics.
Owner submits for review; reviewers comment, approve or request changes.
On approval, owner clicks Publish and sets effective date and acknowledgement requirement.
Affected users receive acknowledgement tasks; the prior version becomes Superseded.

items.label: Generate a controlled PDF
stepTexts: User opens Templates and selects an approved template.
A guided form captures permitted business fields and linked record references.
User clicks Preview PDF and checks content, clinic branding and version.
User generates the PDF and chooses Store, Email through an approved workflow or Attach to Record.
The generated document is logged with template version and creator.

items.label: Complete scheduled review
stepTexts: Document owner opens Review Due and selects a record.
The review screen shows current version, usage links, incidents/gaps and prior review notes.
Owner chooses Confirm Current, Revise or Retire.
If revised, the document follows the approval and publication workflow.
The next review date is recorded and the review history remains visible.

items.label: Document Retention, Legal Hold and Controlled Disposal
stepTexts: A document or record reaches its retention review date.
Owner reviews record category, business need, linked matters and any existing hold.
Owner selects Retain, Extend, Archive, Dispose or Place on Legal Hold.
Sensitive or bulk disposal is submitted for authorised approval.
Approved disposal follows the controlled method and records authority, date and evidence.
A legal hold prevents disposal, replacement or other action that would compromise the held record.
When the hold is released, the record returns to retention review rather than being immediately deleted.

items.label: Workforce Data Access and Correction Request
stepTexts: User opens self-service and submits an access or correction request.
The request identifies the record/category and explains the requested correction where applicable.
Authorised owner reviews identity, scope, sensitivity and any linked legal/retention restriction.
For access, permitted information is prepared and restricted third-party or sensitive information is excluded where appr
For correction, the source owner approves, rejects or requests evidence.
Approved correction updates the source record through normal version/history rules.
The user receives the outcome, reason and completion date.
The request closes with a retained response history.

items.label: Report and resolve a standard issue
stepTexts: Staff member clicks Report Issue or scans an asset QR code.
The form pre-fills clinic/asset where available; staff selects category, impact and description and adds evidence.
The ticket enters Team Queue where a manager confirms priority and assigns an owner.
Owner accepts, updates status and records work notes.
After completion, owner attaches evidence and clicks Mark Work Completed.
Manager reviews and clicks Close or returns the ticket for further work.

items.label: Handle a P1 issue
stepTexts: Reporter identifies a high-impact issue and submits the ticket.
The page displays P1 guidance and immediately notifies defined escalation contacts.
The assigned owner records containment and current service impact.
Updates remain visible in the escalation panel until service is restored.
Manager confirms resolution, root cause follow-up and whether an incident/RCA is required before closure.

items.label: Create a vendor work order
stepTexts: Manager opens a ticket and clicks Create Work Order.
The work-order form captures scope, supplier, access window, quote requirement, cost approval and safety/privacy conditi
If a quote is required, the request enters finance/manager approval.
Approved work is scheduled and the vendor/owner records progress.
Completion evidence, invoice reference and manager sign-off close the work order and related ticket.

items.label: Printer fault workflow
stepTexts: User opens Printers in Inventory & Assets and clicks Raise Fault, or reports via QR.
Ticket receives printer location, model, serial, IP/queue and current toner/counter context.
Triage determines consumable, configuration, network or hardware issue and assigns internal support or supplier.
If unavailable, the fallback printer is displayed and staff are notified.
After repair, test-page evidence and service notes are added; counters/service history update on closure.

items.label: Duplicate Ticket Detection and Ticket Merging
stepTexts: A reporter submits a ticket and the page displays possible existing matches.
Reporter may open the existing ticket or continue if the issue is different.
Triage user reviews related tickets and selects Merge as Duplicate where appropriate.
One ticket becomes the master operational record; duplicate tickets retain their original reporter and submission.
Duplicate reporters continue receiving authorised progress and closure updates.
SLA, assignment, work order and root-cause follow-up are managed from the master ticket.
Closing the master ticket updates linked duplicates while preserving each history.

items.label: Contractor Arrival, Site Access and Work Completion
stepTexts: Approved work order schedules the contractor visit and nominates a site contact.
On arrival, the contractor or site contact opens Check In Contractor.
Identity, supplier, work order and permitted areas are confirmed.
Required safety, privacy and access conditions are acknowledged.
Work progress and any change in scope are recorded.
At completion, evidence, test results, parts used and outstanding work are recorded.
Site contact checks the area/asset and completes contractor check-out.
Manager signs off the work order or returns it for further work.

items.label: In-Product Help, Support and Feedback
stepTexts: User opens Help from any page.
The panel displays guidance relevant to the user's role and current workflow.
User searches or opens the recommended instruction.
If unresolved, user clicks Report a Problem.
The support form carries current page/module/record context and allows description and attachment.
The resulting ticket appears in My Support Requests.
User receives updates and may confirm resolution or provide feedback.

items.label: Customer Support Escalation and Service-Impact Communication
stepTexts: Customer raises a support request and selects the affected area and impact.
Support triages severity and assigns an owner and target.
Where investigation requires tenant data, support requests time-limited access with reason and scope.
Customer/authorised owner approves, rejects or limits access.
Support provides progress updates and workarounds.
If multiple tenants are affected, an approved service-impact communication is issued without exposing other customers.
Resolution is confirmed with the customer and temporary access expires.
For significant events, a post-incident summary and prevention actions are recorded.

items.label: Low-stock reorder
stepTexts: Inventory owner opens Low Stock & Orders and reviews items below PAR.
User selects items and clicks Create Purchase Request.
The request groups items by supplier and clinic and shows expected quantity/cost.
Authorised manager approves or adjusts the request.
On delivery, user clicks Receive Stock, records quantities and discrepancies, and updates on-hand balance.

items.label: Supplier invoice OCR
stepTexts: Finance/inventory user opens Invoice OCR and uploads an invoice.
The split view displays extracted supplier, invoice number/date, GST, total and line items with confidence flags.
User corrects fields and links items, order and clinic.
Duplicate and price-change warnings are reviewed and resolved.
User submits for approval; after approval, invoice register and permitted stock receipts update.
The original invoice and approved extract remain linked.

items.label: Inter-clinic stock transfer
stepTexts: User opens Transfers & Adjustments and clicks Transfer Stock.
The form captures source clinic, destination clinic, items, quantities, reason and responsible staff.
Source owner dispatches and destination owner receives.
Any discrepancy requires reason and manager review.
Both clinic balances and the movement history update after receipt confirmation.

items.label: Add and service an asset
stepTexts: Asset owner opens Assets & Equipment and clicks Add Asset.
The wizard captures category, criticality, clinic/room, owner, serial, warranty, supplier and service/calibration schedu
A QR label is generated and the asset becomes Active.
Before service due date, an action appears in Service Calendar.
Service completion records provider, date, outcome, evidence and next due date.

items.label: Add and manage a printer
stepTexts: IT/asset user opens Printers and clicks Add Printer.
The form captures physical, asset, network, queue, driver, toner, counter, supplier, support and fallback details.
User saves and performs a readiness review; incomplete operational fields remain amber.
Toner and service due alerts appear in the module and Action Inbox.
A fault can be raised directly from the printer profile and follows the work-order flow.

items.label: Supplier contract review
stepTexts: Contract owner opens Suppliers & Contracts and selects a contract due for review.
The review screen shows spend, tickets, SLA, price changes, incidents and expiry terms.
Owner records Renew, Renegotiate, Replace or End recommendation.
Required approval and follow-up actions are assigned.
The outcome, new dates and documents are stored in contract history.

items.label: Stocktake, Expiry, Batch Recall and Product Return
stepTexts: Manager creates a full or cycle stocktake and assigns count areas.
Staff count items and submit quantities and notes.
The platform compares counted and recorded quantities and creates variance review items.
Authorised manager approves adjustments and the stock balance updates with history.
For expiry or recall, the owner selects the affected item/batch and locates quantities by clinic and room.
Affected stock is quarantined and made unavailable for normal use.
The owner records return to supplier, transfer, write-off or other approved disposition.
Completion evidence and unresolved quantities are reviewed before the recall/expiry action is closed.

items.label: Supplier Onboarding, Quote Comparison and Supplier Suspension
stepTexts: Owner clicks Onboard Supplier and completes identity, contacts, service categories, evidence and terms.
Required due-diligence items are assigned for review.
Where procurement comparison is required, quotes are entered and compared against the same scope.
Approver records the selected supplier and rationale.
Approved supplier becomes selectable for permitted work and orders.
Expired evidence, serious performance issues or incidents trigger a restriction/suspension review.
Authorised manager suspends, reinstates or ends the supplier and open work is reassigned where necessary.

items.label: Asset Assignment, Loan, Loss, Return and Decommissioning
stepTexts: Asset owner selects an active asset and clicks Assign / Loan Asset.
Holder, clinic, issue date, expected return date and condition are recorded.
Recipient acknowledges receipt and any use conditions.
Transfers and extensions are recorded as new movement events.
On return, the asset is inspected and condition/evidence are recorded.
If lost or stolen, the user records the event and links an incident, access review or replacement action.
For retirement, owner confirms data/access removal, disposal method, approval and final status.

items.label: Report and investigate an incident
stepTexts: Reporter clicks Report Incident and selects category, clinic, date/time, immediate risk and description.
Urgent guidance appears; reporter records immediate action and submits.
Triage owner reviews severity, confidentiality and required escalation.
Investigator builds chronology, adds evidence and records contributing factors.
RCA/CAPA actions are created and assigned.
When actions and evidence meet closure criteria, investigator submits closure and authorised manager approves.

items.label: Manage a complaint
stepTexts: Manager logs or receives a complaint through the controlled intake path.
The complaint record captures service theme, preferred contact pathway, acknowledgement due and owner without unnecessar
Owner investigates, records communication and creates service recovery actions.
If risk or serious event is identified, the record links to an incident.
Manager approves response and closure; themes feed Service Quality reporting.

items.label: Activate downtime plan
stepTexts: Authorised user opens Business Continuity and clicks Activate Plan.
The event form captures affected clinic/service, start time, impact and decision owner.
The event board displays critical contacts, approved workaround checklists and communications.
Teams update status until recovery is confirmed.
Owner records recovery time, outstanding actions and post-event review; lessons create follow-up actions.

items.label: Privacy/cyber response
stepTexts: User logs a suspected privacy/cyber event with minimal necessary detail.
The restricted workflow prompts immediate containment and responsible-owner notification.
Owner assesses scope, affected systems/records, evidence and required advice/notification decisions.
Corrective actions, access reviews, communication and training tasks are assigned.
Closure requires documented assessment, actions and review approval.

items.label: Anonymous or Near-Miss Reporting and Complaint Review
stepTexts: Reporter selects Report Near Miss or confidential reporting pathway and records minimum necessary facts.
The report enters restricted triage with identity visibility limited according to the chosen pathway and approved rules.
Triage owner assesses severity, immediate controls and whether investigation is required.
Near misses may create prevention actions without being treated as completed harm events.
For complaints, the owner records acknowledgement, investigation, response and service-recovery actions.
If the complainant remains dissatisfied, an authorised review or escalation is opened.
External regulator, insurer, legal or other referral decisions are recorded where applicable.
Final outcome and lessons feed trends without exposing unnecessary identity.

items.label: Scenario-Based Business Continuity and Exercise
stepTexts: Authorised user selects a scenario and chooses Live Event or Exercise.
The plan records affected clinic/services, start time, decision owner and current impact.
Roles, contacts and approved workaround checklists are assigned.
Internal/external operational communications are issued as required.
Teams update service status, risks and workaround progress.
When service is restored, the owner confirms recovery and identifies any backlog created during downtime.
Backlog reconciliation and outstanding actions are completed.
A post-event or exercise review records lessons, plan changes, training and follow-up actions.

items.label: Create and send a campaign
stepTexts: User clicks Create Email Campaign or Create SMS Campaign.
The stepper captures purpose, clinic/brand, approved audience source and exclusions.
User selects a template, edits permitted content and previews the message.
User sends a test and resolves validation warnings.
User submits for approval; approver reviews exact content, audience count and schedule.
After approval, the campaign is scheduled or sent and delivery appears in the dashboard.

items.label: Handle failed deliveries
stepTexts: User opens Delivery and filters to Failed.
The page groups failures by invalid address/number, temporary failure, suppression or gateway issue.
User selects eligible temporary failures and clicks Retry Failed.
Permanent failures are marked for source-data correction and do not retry automatically.
The campaign report shows original and retry outcomes without double-counting.

items.label: Update suppression
stepTexts: Authorised user opens Consent & Suppression and searches the contact reference.
User records the approved preference or opt-out source and effective date.
The interface confirms which channels are suppressed.
Future campaign audience previews automatically exclude the suppressed contact.
Any authorised reversal requires reason and evidence.

items.label: Emergency Communication and Campaign Cancellation
stepTexts: Authorised user selects an approved emergency template and links the relevant incident, outage or clinic transition.
Audience, clinic scope, exclusions and communication channel are confirmed.
Urgent approval is completed according to severity rules.
Message is sent and delivery failures are prioritised for review.
Further updates and the all-clear remain linked to the original communication event.
For a scheduled normal campaign, user may cancel before sending and records a reason.
If content or audience changes after approval, the approval expires and the revised version must be reviewed again.
If a send can be paused, successful recipients are not sent duplicates when activity resumes.

items.label: Website outage response
stepTexts: Monitoring identifies repeated failures and creates an outage alert.
IT user opens Website Monitoring and reviews status, response history and affected site.
User acknowledges the alert and creates a ticket/incident if required.
Updates and recovery time are recorded.
After recovery, the outage closes and monthly uptime reporting updates.

items.label: Remote access request
stepTexts: Support user opens Remote Access and selects an endpoint.
User clicks Request Access and enters purpose, expected duration and related ticket.
Approver reviews sensitivity and scope and approves, rejects or limits duration.
User launches the approved session; start/end and reason are logged.
The session closes and any emergency or unusual access enters review.

items.label: High-risk secret access
stepTexts: User opens Password / Secrets and requests access to a restricted record.
The request shows owner, sensitivity, reason and linked ticket/change.
Approver grants time-limited reveal/copy permission or rejects.
User performs the allowed action; the event is logged.
If rotation is required after use, a rotation task is created and tracked.

items.label: Camera footage request
stepTexts: Authorised user opens Security Cameras and clicks Request Footage.
The form captures camera/zone, date/time range, purpose and intended use/export.
Approver reviews privacy, scope and authority.
Approved viewing/export is performed through the controlled source and logged.
The request closes with outcome, evidence reference and retention instruction.

items.label: Review clinic capacity
stepTexts: Manager opens Capacity & Flow and selects clinic and period.
Aggregate charts show demand, provider availability, waiting indicators and utilisation.
Manager selects an outlier and opens contributing summary, not patient records.
Manager clicks Create Action to address roster, opening hours, provider coverage or process issue.
The action is assigned and tracked through Action Inbox and later trend review.

items.label: Correct data-quality issue
stepTexts: Data owner opens Data Quality and filters to Critical.
The page shows missing/duplicate/stale record, affected workflows and assigned owner.
Owner opens the source record and corrects or submits a merge/review decision.
Reviewer confirms the correction where sensitive or high-impact.
The next quality check clears the exception and updates the clinic data-health score.

items.label: Manage a business change
stepTexts: Owner clicks Raise Change and records reason, desired outcome, affected clinics and effective date.
Impact Assessment prompts review of staff, policies, training, checklists, communications, privacy, finance and downtime
Required actions and approvers are assigned.
When readiness items are complete, approver confirms Go Live / Effective.
After implementation, owner starts Post-Change Review and records outcomes, incidents and further actions.

items.label: Failed Change, Rollback and Benefit-Realisation Review
stepTexts: After implementation, the change owner records actual performance and any incidents, complaints or gaps.
If the change is unsafe or unsuccessful, the owner selects Pause, Rollback or Correct Forward.
The impact panel identifies affected clinics, users, policies, training, communications and records.
Required approval is obtained and affected users are notified.
Rollback/correction actions are executed and linked incidents/tickets are monitored.
The owner confirms stabilisation and records any permanent revisions.
At the scheduled benefits review, expected and actual outcomes, cost, risk and lessons are compared.
Further improvement actions are created or the change is formally closed.

items.label: Onboard a tenant
stepTexts: Commercial admin opens Tenants and clicks Add Tenant.
The wizard captures customer identity, contacts, plan, modules, contract dates and support owner.
Tenant admin is invited and completes clinic, user and business-setting information.
Onboarding checklist covers configuration, training, sample workflows and acceptance.
Commercial admin completes Configuration Review and activates the tenant.

items.label: Grant support access
stepTexts: Support user opens Support Access and selects the tenant and related support ticket.
The request captures purpose, modules, duration and required data scope.
Tenant or authorised owner approves, rejects or limits the request.
A visible banner remains during the support-access period.
Access expires automatically according to the approved business duration and enters review history.

items.label: Manage renewal
stepTexts: Commercial manager opens Renewals and selects a tenant approaching renewal.
The screen shows adoption, open issues, plan, modules, support history and contract date.
Manager records renewal recommendation and creates customer actions.
Approved changes to modules/plan are scheduled for the renewal date.
Renewal outcome and next review date are stored.

items.label: Offboard tenant
stepTexts: Authorised admin clicks Start Offboarding.
Checklist identifies open actions, support access, users, reports, documents and agreed export/retention steps.
Tenant admin confirms required exports and closure date.
Access is suspended, outstanding responsibilities are completed and closure is reviewed.
Tenant is archived with a formal offboarding record.

items.label: Commercial Plan Upgrade, Downgrade and Subscription Billing
stepTexts: Tenant administrator or commercial manager opens the current plan and selects Upgrade, Downgrade or Change Modules.
The page shows entitlement, limits, price/effective-date summary and operational impact.
Required customer and internal approvals are completed.
Upgrade changes activate on the approved date; downgrade identifies records/actions requiring completion or export first
Billing-contact changes are confirmed and recorded.
A failed subscription payment creates a commercial action and approved customer communication.
If unresolved, tenant access may be restricted according to contract while essential offboarding/export options remain a
On resolution, authorised user reinstates the tenant and records the outcome.

items.label: Customer Support Escalation and Service-Impact Communication
stepTexts: Customer raises a support request and selects the affected area and impact.
Support triages severity and assigns an owner and target.
Where investigation requires tenant data, support requests time-limited access with reason and scope.
Customer/authorised owner approves, rejects or limits access.
Support provides progress updates and workarounds.
If multiple tenants are affected, an approved service-impact communication is issued without exposing other customers.
Resolution is confirmed with the customer and temporary access expires.
For significant events, a post-incident summary and prevention actions are recorded.
